review.note: M59: 1885 is where Historical Basemaps stops, not where this polity ended. The nearest 1886-side record is `congo-under-france` — 0.0687 of the smaller outline, 0.0129 of the union, which is below M51's cut of 0.50: whatever the names say, this is not the same ground, and Wikidata gives no dissolution this record could cite (docs/m59-singletons.md). The end here is the horizon of the source and nothing more.

summary: A polity the Historical Basemaps dataset draws in the snapshots for 1492, 1500, 1530, 1600, 1650, 1700, 1715, 1783, 1800, 1815, 1878 and 1880. That dataset is a set of world border snapshots from antiquity to the twentieth century; it is its authors' work in progress and asks to be checked against other sources before use. The source calls it "Congo"; the names on this record are the ones data/imports/basemaps-actors.json gives it. The interval on this record is the span those snapshots cover, 1492 to 1885, and not a claim about when this polity began or ended: a snapshot says where a border was drawn for one year, and the years between two of them are assumed. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
